hooks.logic:
Count up "currentTurn".
Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of the enemy.
Let v be currentParamSuffixNo.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of the enemy.
Let v2 be the count "currentTurn".
If currentParamSuffixNo is "1", then
  If v2 is more than the numeric entry "turn_count_to_phase_2" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then set v to "2".
  If hpRate is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_2" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then set v to "2".
  If hpRate is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_3" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then set v to "3".
Otherwise, if currentParamSuffixNo is "2", then
  If v2 is more than the numeric entry "turn_count_to_phase_3" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then set v to "3".
  If hpRate is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_3" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then set v to "3".
Otherwise, if currentParamSuffixNo is "3" and v2 is more than the numeric entry "turn_count_to_phase_4" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then set v to "4".
If v is not currentParamSuffixNo, then
  The enemy changes to form v.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let ability be a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
  If ability is the id of the move labelled "kyo_embrace" on the enemy, then
    Let bundle be call game:StatusAilmentsConfig.getBundle with (game:Conf.STATUS_AILMENTS_BUNDLE.ESNA).
    The enemy uses ability with its cast time and then [{abilityId: ability}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: bundle, saChildNos: [1]}]]}}].
  Otherwise, the enemy uses ability.
